description: This Java class, NoteMapper, provides static methods to convert between Note entities and DTOs (NoteRequest and NoteResponse). It facilitates mapping data for API operations, such as creating or updating notes.

classes.name: NoteMapper
classes.description: Utility class for mapping between Note entity and DTOs, with static methods for conversion.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a NoteRequest DTO to a new Note entity (without setting id).

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Updates an existing Note entity's title and content fields based on a NoteRequest.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Note entity to a NoteResponse DTO, including its id, timestamps, title, and content.
